title: A user who picks Internal market can walk past the purpose question and reach the next page with no message; DR1 stops them there and then with 'Select a purpose in the internal market'.

finding.frontend: Picking Internal market sends the user to a page of its own, 'Purpose in the internal market', with eleven radios. Save and continue with none of them chosen is accepted: the empty value passes validation, the page saves and the user goes on (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/import-purpose/controller.js:25-30). Nothing on the page says the answer is needed and no message is ever shown for a missing purpose. The service does hold the rule, but only later: the obligation model makes the purpose mandatory whenever the reason is internalMarket (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js), so the reason hub row stays incomplete and Check your answers cannot be opened until the purpose is chosen. The user meets a page that accepts an empty answer and a hub that will not let them finish, with nothing joining the two up.
finding.prototype: DR1 will not let the reason page be saved with Internal market chosen and no purpose behind it. Save and continue returns the page with 'There is a problem' and one entry, 'Select a purpose in the internal market', and the same message appears in red inside the reveal above the eleven radios, with the reveal left open and the red bar running down its edge. The summary link moves focus to the first radio (app/routes.js:1387-1394). This is the state the captured error screen shows. DR1 carries the rule at the later points too — the hub reads the reason task as complete only when the purpose is present (app/routes.js:1343-1367), and Continue on the review page is refused without it (app/routes.js:10068-10075).
finding.difference: Add the page-level check the frontend is missing, so the user is told at the point of the mistake instead of finding a hub row they cannot clear: reject a submit with Internal market chosen and no purpose, with 'Select a purpose in the internal market' in the summary and against the field. The obligation is already mandatory under Internal market, so this is a validator change on one page and nothing in the model moves. Where the message is shown depends on the reveal change: while purpose is a page of its own the error belongs on that page, and once it moves inline it belongs in the reveal, as DR1 shows it. Do this first — it stands on its own.
finding.falsifiedBy: Submitting DR1's reason page with Internal market chosen and no purpose selected and reaching the next screen.
finding.correction: Overstated; slot rewritten, claim stands in a narrower form. CLAIMED: the user 'can walk past the purpose question without answering it' and 'no error is ever shown for a missing purpose'. TRUE of the page, not of the journey. purposeInInternalMarket is mandatory in the obligation model whenever reasonForImport is internalMarket (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/obligations/sections/import-reason.js, equalsGate to status 'mandatory'), which feeds rowStatus in flow/task-rows.js and readyForCheckYourAnswers in src/server/app/flow/section-status.js:11-15; the whole review section is gated on that (flow.js:81-85). So the frontend refuses to open Check your answers without a purpose — it just never says why, and never at the point of the mistake. The real difference is where the rule bites, not whether it exists. HOW CHECKED: read the import-purpose page validator, the import-reason obligation section, the status roll-up and the review gate on the frontend; read validateImportReasonProceed, hasImportReasonComplete and the review POST on DR1.

relatedTo.why: the reveal change decides where this error is shown
